Transkold specializes in the storage and distribution of multi temperature product originating from, or destined to, the London and the home counties areas.
WELCOME TO LONDON’S CLOSEST COLD STORAGE
If you’re searching for flexible cold storage in London, Transkold is here to help. Our cold store is the largest in North London and can hold up to 2500 pallets between our frozen storage chamber, and our chill store, so whether you have just one pallet, or hundreds, we can support your business.
We also have a range of supporting services, from Pick Pack and Cross Docking, to Lorry Parking, and the best Refrigerated Transport London has to offer.
Transkold specialises in food importers looking for a cold store close to the large client base of London.
Whether you’re a food importer looking for cold storage in London to be close to you client base, or a food manufacturer looking for a cold store to blast freeze and consolidate production, we have you covered.

History Transkold was formed in 1988 as a public cold storage facility in Stanmore, having taken over a building formally used by Iceland. In 2011 Transkold has changed ownership, and is now undergoing a full regeneration program of works, and updating to return the cold store back to a BRC accredited cold storage facility. We have 420,000 cubic feet of storage space, accompanied by 5000sqft of office space.
We are currently undertaking a build program to increase this square footage to 10,000 sqft of modern serviced offices. Official Information Company Name – TranskoldLimited Company No – 1513741 Registered Office – 7 Parr Road, Stanmore, Middlesex, HA7 1NP VAT No – 863639686
